issues.description: generate-stories requires an existing data/stories/manifest.json before it can generate the story dataset, so the documented bootstrap path fails on a fresh checkout.
last_token_activations indexes model outputs with CPU tensors, which is likely to fail when the model is running on CUDA.
choice_logits leaves choice_ids, idx, and last on CPU while indexing logits that may be on CUDA, breaking GPU execution.
from_pretrained uses dtype instead of the broadly supported torch_dtype argument despite allowing transformers>=4.42, making dtype behavior version-dependent.
load_stories ignores manifest metadata and does not validate expected emotions/topics/counts or empty files, so mislabeled or incomplete datasets can silently corrupt vector extraction.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaN vectors when any emotion has zero examples instead of failing with a clear validation error.
span_mean_activations silently returns zero activations when a character span maps to no tokens, which can invalidate preference-correlation results without warning.
story generation sends requests with no timeout or retry/backoff, so a network/API stall can hang the pipeline indefinitely.
pca_components does not handle zero-variance or degenerate inputs, leading to divide-by-zero NaNs instead of a clean no-component result.
the only end-to-end test depends on the gated real model and the missing story dataset, so CI cannot deterministically verify the full pipeline.
dependencies are broad lower bounds only for a numerically sensitive ML pipeline, making results and API compatibility non-reproducible across installs.
ignored generated directories are present in the working tree as emovec.egg-info and outputs/tiny artifacts, while the required input story data is absent.
